detail.longDescription:
A massive Microsoft outage made headlines today — and I only found out about it this afternoon, because everyone was talking about it.

Last year I switched completely to Linux and started self-hosting my own services. While half the internet spent the day wrestling with downed servers, my little setup (pictured) quietly did its job in the corner of my office. Files served, backups running, lights blinking. Business as usual.

That's not luck — that was the whole point. When your stuff doesn't depend on someone else's servers, a giant cloud outage becomes something you read about instead of something you live through.

I'm not saying everyone needs a Raspberry Pi on their desk (though I'm not NOT saying that). I'm saying every service you move off someone else's machine and onto your own is one more thing that keeps working when theirs doesn't.

Longtime open source supporter, and this afternoon felt like vindication.

#Linux #SelfHosting #FOSS #OpenSource
